Subject: Prep: Demo checklist and technical asks

Hi Samir / Marissa — jumping in with the technical prep so we can make the Feb 20 session actionable.

Summary of asks (short):
1) Workload sample: a CSV with columns (timestamp, request_id, prompt_token_count, response_token_count, QPS_sample) for a representative day; 10-100 rows is fine. If you can't share production data, anonymized traces are fine.
2) Prompt sets: the prompt_set_v2.txt Marissa attached is a good format. If you have multiple workload classes (e.g., inference for personalization vs. billing memos), please label them.
3) Access: if you want us to validate a private deployment path, provide a short-lived S3 URL or a workspace Drive link with sample payloads; otherwise screenshots are fine.

I uploaded a lightweight checklist (redwood-demo-checklist.pdf) to the shared Drive and added comments on what we'll demo vs. what requires longer setup (e.g., full VPC peering). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/abcd1234-demo-prep

If you can drop the sample CSV into that folder and confirm expected peak QPS and target latency, Neha and I will tailor the demo to show batching/quantization recommendations and targeted SLOs.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Principal Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: workload_traces_sample.csv (text/csv), redwood-demo-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)
